propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache consumes 92% (approximately 1 GiB) of the tickets branch due to bookkeeping fields that are not read by the application: baseline_advanced_at is written but never read, and last_get_pass is rotation metadata only.

Scattered edits across the sorted 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression, costing 12.79 KB per version today; removing baseline_advanced_at and moving last_get_pass to a sidecar file would reduce marginal cost to 1.74 KB per version (7.4x improvement, 12.8x combined).

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/fast-import can reclaim 1.08 GiB (from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with HEAD tree byte-identical to pre-rewrite tip after dynamic re-add of current state.

Implementation requires coordinated changes: remove baseline_advanced_at field writes, move last_get_pass to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json with mixed-version read compatibility, normalize baseline description/status/priority fields, narrow prev_snapshot.json to key-set only, and introduce store-epoch guards before and after history rewrite.

Reclaim execution requires operator-attested quiescence: zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, no in-flight reconciler or review-bot writes, verified off-repo backup bundle, and deployed writer enforcement of epoch mismatch refusal as fail-closed safety signal.

Post-publish rollback is explicit and non-resumable: restore old tip with --force-with-lease, reset all writer clones to restored state, re-run verification, and re-enable writers in forward order; epoch mismatch refusal is the safety signal, never bypassed.
